title: Adaptive Recuperation Learning Curve
summary: Feedback centers on adaptive recuperation, with one complaint that it is hard to get used to and one fragment that only states energy recovery without a clear evaluation.

negative.summary: The negative feedback says adaptive recuperation is hard to get used to, with a reference to reducing its strength through settings.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined feedback only states that the system recovers energy and does not clearly indicate satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

limitations: The topic is based on only two reviews, so examples are limited.
One negative review includes explanatory or instructional wording, which limits detail about the underlying customer experience.
